arxiv-2012-00912.title: DYNAMAP: Dyna mic Algorithm Map ping Framework for Low Latency CNN Inference Conference: Proceedings of the 2021 ACM/SIGDA International Symposium on Field Programmable Gate Arrays; February 28-March 2, 2021; Virtual Event, USA Proceedings of the 2021 ACM/SIGDA International Symposium on Field Progr
arxiv-2012-00912.creator: Yuan Meng, Sanmukh Kuppannagari, Rajgopal Kannan, Viktor Prasanna
arxiv-2012-00912.description: Abstract . Most of the existing work on FPGA acceleration of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) focus on employing a single strategy (algorithm, dataflow, etc.) across all the layers. Such an approach does not achieve optimal latency on complex and deep CNNs. Emerging CNNs have diverse per-layer computation characteristics including parallelism, arithmetic intensity, locality, and memory footprint.

arxiv-2105-00210.title: Better than the Best: Gradient-based Improper Reinforcement Learning for Network Scheduling
arxiv-2105-00210.creator: Mohammadi Zaki, Avi Mohan, Aditya Gopalan and Shie Mannor
arxiv-2105-00210.description: Abstract We consider the problem of scheduling in constrained queueing networks with a view to minimizing packet delay. We formulate a novel top down approach to scheduling where, given an unknown network and a set of scheduling policies, we use a policy gradient based reinforcement learning algorithm that produces a scheduler that performs better than the available atomic policies.

arxiv-2204-06449.creator: Gautam Nagaraj, John C. Forbes, Joel Leja, Dan Foreman-Mackey, Christopher C. Hayward
arxiv-2204-06449.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gautam Nagaraj, John C. Forbes, Joel Leja, Dan Foreman-Mackey, Christopher C. Hayward. Dust attenuation varies substantially from galaxy to galaxy and as of yet cannot be reproduced from first principles in theoretical models. 2022 , we developed the first Bayesian population model of dust attenuation as a function of stellar population properties and projected galaxy shape, built on spectral energy distribution (SED) fits of nearly 30,000 galaxies in the 3D-HST grism survey with broadband photometric coverage from the rest-frame UV to IR.

arxiv-2304-03843.title: Why think step by step? Reasoning emerges from the locality of experience
arxiv-2304-03843.creator: Ben Prystawski, Michael Y. Li, Noah D. Goodman
arxiv-2304-03843.description: Abstract Humans have a powerful and mysterious capacity to reason. Working through a set of mental steps enables us to make inferences we would not be capable of making directly even though we get no additional data from the world.

arxiv-2304-04969.title: Poisson Equation and Application to Multi-Scale SDEs with State-Dependent Switching
arxiv-2304-04969.creator: Xiaobin Sunsun, Yingchao Xie
arxiv-2304-04969.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study the averaging principle and central limit theorem for multi-scale stochastic differential equations with state-dependent switching. To accomplish this, we first study the Poisson equation associated with a Markov chain and the regularity of its solutions.

arxiv-2411-08289.title: Breakdown of continuum elasticity due to electronic effects in gold nanotubes
arxiv-2411-08289.creator: Shota Ono, Hideo Yoshioka
arxiv-2411-08289.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shota Ono, Hideo Yoshioka. A recent experiment reports a creation of goldene, which is two-dimensional gold with hexagonal structure. By rolling up the goldene, gold nanotubes (GNT) should exist, but their structural and electronic properties are not understood well. Based on first-principles calculations, we demonstrate a breakdown of inverse square law, wherein the curvature energy stored in a GNT decreases with the inverse square of the GNT radius.

arxiv-2505-01262.title: Thinking Outside the Template with Modular GP-GOMEA
arxiv-2505-01262.creator: Joe Harrison, Tanja Alderliesten, Peter A.N. Bosman
arxiv-2505-01262.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Joe Harrison, Tanja Alderliesten, Peter A.N. Bosman. The goal in Symbolic Regression (SR) is to discover expressions that accurately map input to output data. Because often the intent is to understand these expressions, there is a trade-off between accuracy and the interpretability of expressions. GP-GOMEA excels at producing small SR expressions (increasing the potential for interpretability) with high accuracy, but requires a fixed tree template, which limits the types of expressions that can be evolved.

arxiv-2510-02276.title: BioX-Bridge: Model Bridging for Unsupervised Cross-Modal Knowledge Transfer across Biosignals
arxiv-2510-02276.creator: Chenqi Li, Yu Liu, Timothy Denison, Tingting Zhu
arxiv-2510-02276.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chenqi Li, Yu Liu, Timothy Denison, Tingting Zhu. Biosignals offer valuable insights into the physiological states of the human body. Although biosignal modalities differ in functionality, signal fidelity, sensor comfort, and cost, they are often intercorrelated, reflecting the holistic and interconnected nature of human physiology. This opens up the possibility of performing the same tasks using alternative biosignal modalities, thereby improving the accessibility, usability, and adaptability of health monitoring systems.

pmc-11334349.title: VALIDITY OF THE EKBLOM-BAK CYCLE ERGOMETER TEST IN PATIENTS WITH CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASE
pmc-11334349.creator: Magnus FRANSPLASS STORLI, Marius STEIRO FIMLAND, Harald Kåre ENGAN, Jon Arne SANDMÆL
pmc-11334349.description: ObjectiveTo assess the validity of the Ekblom-Bak cycle ergometer test in patients with cardiovascular disease admitted to cardiac rehabilitation.MethodsEstimated peak oxygen consumption from the Ekblom-Bak test was compared with directly measured peak oxygen consumption from a treadmill cardiopulmonary exercise test. Patients completed the cardiopulmonary exercise test first, followed by the Ekblom-Bak test after 24 h rest.

pmc-11653543.title: Association of anthropometric parameters with intelligence quotient in early school-aged children: a cross-sectional study in Iran
pmc-11653543.creator: Kimia Mahjubi, Mohammad Effatpanah, Mohammadamin Parsaei, Sayed Yousef Mojtahedi, Anahita Izadi, Reza Tavakolizadeh
pmc-11653543.description: BackgroundWhile the link between body growth indices in the first three years of life and neurodevelopment is well established, the relationship between these indicators and intelligence levels in later stages is not well understood. This study aimed to investigate the association between various anthropometric indices and Intelligence Quotient in early school-aged children.

pmc-11727680.title: Relationship Between Population Density, Availability of Gynecological Services, and Cervical Cancer Incidence and Mortality Across Administrative Units in Serbia and Bosnia and Herzegovina During 2016–2020
pmc-11727680.creator: Vladimir Vuković, Mirjana Štrbac, Mioljub Ristić, Siniša Skočibušić, Šeila Cilović-Lagarija, Jela Aćimović, Slađana Šiljak, Snežana Živković Perišić, Nataša Nikolić, Stefan Ljubičić, Tatjana Pustahija, Smiljana Rajčević, Aleksandra Patić, Tihomir Dugandžija, Aljoša Mandić, Vladimir Petrović, Pietro
pmc-11727680.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background and Objectives: Burden of cervical cancer in Central and Eastern Europe is higher than in other parts of Europe. We analyzed cervical cancer epidemiology in Serbia and Bosnia and Herzegovina (the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina and the Republic of Srpska) from January 2016 to December 2020, exploring the role of available sociodemographic factors and healthcare service parameters on incidence and mortality rates, using an ecological approach based on aggregated data.

pmc-12473845.title: Effects of Abscisic Acid Induction on the Underground Weed Inhibition Strategies of Allelopathic and Non-Allelopathic Rice Accessions
pmc-12473845.creator: Jiayu Li, Ting Wang, Xinyi Ye, Shuyu Chen, Yanping Wang, Changxun Fang, Yongjie Yang
pmc-12473845.description: Despite our preliminary research about the inductive effect of exogenous abscisic acid (ABA) on the weed-suppressive activity of rice in a hydroponic system, there is a lack of knowledge regarding the induction mechanism for ABA application to enhance the ability for weed control underground.

pmc-12609741.title: Effect of Shielding Gas and Post-Welding Heat Treatment on the Mechanical and Corrosion Performances of Duplex and Super Duplex Stainless Steels’ Low Heat-Input Welded Joints
pmc-12609741.creator: Elisa Ferrari, Elena Colombini, Roberto Giovanardi, Francesco Zaniboni, Silvia Gaiani, Paolo Veronesi, Shinichi Tashiro
pmc-12609741.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The purpose of this paper is to study the weldability of two specific steels, UNS S31803 (duplex) and UNS S 32760 (super duplex), by making heterogeneous butt joints using gas tungsten arc welding technology. These materials are widely used in applications that take advantage of their superior corrosion resistance, strength, or both, such as chemical plants, oil and gas equipment, offshore sector, marine and other high-chloride environments.

pmc-12714278.title: 2025: A year of resilience and resourcefulness
pmc-12714278.creator: Joanna Clarke, on behalf of the PLOS Biology Staff Editors
pmc-12714278.description: 2025 was marked by upheaval and uncertainty for many within the life science community. As we reflect on the year that has gone, we highlight some of the many research achievements that give us reasons to be thankful. 2025 will be remembered as a year that sent shockwaves through the scientific community.

pmc-13131131.description: Highlights•This ESMO CPG provides key recommendations and algorithms for diagnosis, staging, treatment and follow-up of UM.•This ESMO CPG focuses solely on UM; refer to the ESMO CPG on Cutaneous Melanoma for other types.•ESMO-MCBS scores are given to describe the levels of evidence for treatment choices.•Recommendations are based on available scientific data and the authors’ collective expert opinion.

pmc-13479745.title: NitroGene: privacy-preserving collaborative genomic analysis using AWS nitro enclaves
pmc-13479745.creator: Zakariya Ali, Arif Harmanci
pmc-13479745.description: MotivationProtecting participant privacy is a major challenge in large-scale biomedical collaborations. We present NitroGene, an open-source framework for privacy-preserving collaborative genomic analysis using AWS Nitro Enclaves. NitroGene uses an architecture consisting of a client application, proxy server, and hardware-isolated enclave, secured through end-to-end 256-bit encryption and cryptographic attestation via the Nitro Security Module.
